# Whop plugin for ChatGPT and Codex

Whop's plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to the Whop businesses you run, through the hosted Whop MCP server (`https://mcp.whop.com/chatgpt/mcp`). Sign in with your Whop account in the browser — no API key is stored or typed into the chat — and then ask in plain language to publish a website built on Whop and buy or connect its domain, create products and checkout links for your customers, look up payments and manage disputes, manage Whop Ads campaigns, get the link to Whop's company formation page, or read your stats. It asks before anything that goes live or costs money. Payouts and other money movement, issuing refunds, and one-off charges to customers are not available in this plugin. For company formation, the plugin gives you the link to Whop's own form, where you enter your details.

## Getting started

1. Install Whop from the Plugins directory in ChatGPT or Codex.
2. Connect Whop when asked. Your browser opens Whop so you can sign in and approve access. To reconnect later, use the Whop plugin's settings. In Codex, type `$whop:whop-connect` to see which business is connected.
3. Describe what you want, for example "who are my newest members this week?" or "how did my revenue change month over month?".

## What's included

- **Whop MCP server** — the tools that act on your Whop account.
- **`whop` skill** — maps each job to the right tools, with guides for websites and domains, ads, and company formation.
- **`whop-connect` setup skill** — checks you are signed in and names the account it can reach.
